title: 98% of classical knowledge lost
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of 98% of classical knowledge lost, about late Roman Empire at Library of Alexandria; Corinth, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know that um I'm getting this figure from Carl Sean We lost 98% of the knowledge of classical antiquity.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that we lost 98 percent of the knowledge of the ancient Greek and Roman world, a figure he says he got from the astronomer Carl Sagan. He connects it to places like the Library of Alexandria, the great ancient library in Egypt, and the Greek city of Corinth. If true, it would mean almost everything the ancients knew is gone.
